{{Top|leg}}
This '''[[Human replica droid]]''' was intended to serve as a simulacrum of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Underlord]] [[Dal Perhi]]. Commissioned by [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] proved to be a failure when the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], [[Kaird]], was able to detect the unit's imperfections; upon tactile contact with the [[Nediji]], the droid proceeded to dissolve into a pile of goo. As if to add insult to injury, not long after this disastrous test it was discovered that the HRD's creators had been slaughtered wholesale by a group of [[Feral droid|Feral Droids]], who had also taken the effort to smash the lab's equipment to uselessness.
